title: 32.8% Unemployment Doctrine
subtitle: Founding constraint for Kopano-Phu Eco-Friendly System — not world acceptance
statement: We design and validate for an economy where roughly one in three people seeking work cannot find it. PoC passes when livelihood-relevant measurands improve under sovereign constraints — not when global markets applaud.
what_we_do_not_worship: graduation theater without placement or income pathway

livelihood_signals.name: skill_transfer
livelihood_signals.text: Teacher–student apprenticeship produces a repeatable skill artifact (lab sheet, build, cert prep).

livelihood_signals.name: low_capital_path
livelihood_signals.text: Entry cost fits load-shedding, offline, and low-data reality — no cloud-only gate.

livelihood_signals.name: measurable_output
livelihood_signals.text: STEM measurand with units — something an employer or client can verify without believing a slide deck.

livelihood_signals.name: time_to_useful
livelihood_signals.text: Hours-to-first-useful-output is bounded and logged — unemployment cannot afford infinite courses.

livelihood_signals.name: local_eco_fit
livelihood_signals.text: Reduces waste (water, watts, trust, rehearsal time) in the actual environment, not a datacenter fantasy.
